faq.q: What is the best yacht for a Pride party in Marbella?
faq.a: For groups up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) offer spacious decks, sunbeds, and flybridges perfect for dancing and socialising. For smaller groups, the Azimut 39 (11 pax) or Astondoa 40 (9 pax) are budget-friendly and stylish. All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: How much does a Pride yacht charter cost in Marbella?
faq.a: Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours – all inclusive of skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT. Tier B yachts like the Mangusta 80 start at €4,719 for 4 hours (includes a free jet ski). Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras – just bring your party spirit and sunscreen.

faq.q: Can we bring our own decorations or music for Pride?
faq.a: Absolutely. You're welcome to bring Pride flags, banners, and balloons. Most boats have Bluetooth speakers or auxiliary inputs for your own playlist. Our crew are LGBTQ+ friendly and will help set the vibe. Just let us know in advance.

faq.q: What is the best time of day for a Pride charter?
faq.a: Sunset charters (typically 18:00–20:00 or 19:00–21:00) are magical with golden light over La Concha mountain. For a full-day party, a 4- or 8-hour charter gives you time to anchor at Cala del Faro or Cabopino, swim, and enjoy lunch on board.

faq.q: Do you offer LGBTQ+ friendly crew?
faq.a: Yes, all our skippers and crew are welcoming and professional, regardless of orientation. Marbella is a famously inclusive destination, and we ensure every guest feels comfortable and celebrated. Pride charters are some of our most joyful trips.

faq.q: How do I book a Pride yacht charter in Marbella?
faq.a: You can check availability and book directly via our website or WhatsApp. For Tier A boats, online booking is instant. For larger yachts, contact us for a custom quote. We recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks ahead for Pride week.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on Pride day?
faq.a: We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe, we'll offer you a full refund or reschedule to another day. Generally, Marbella enjoys 300+ sunny days a year, so cancellations are rare. We'll keep you informed every step.

data.body_html:
Marbella's Pride 2033 is set to be the biggest celebration of LGBTQ+ life on the Costa del Sol, and there's no better way to experience it than from the deck of a private yacht. With our fleet of 18 boats departing from Puerto Banús, you can enjoy the freedom of the Mediterranean, stunning coastal views, and a party atmosphere that's entirely your own. Whether you're looking for a sunset cruise for two or a full-day bash with 12 friends, our Marbella yacht charter options make it easy to celebrate Pride your way.

Why Choose a Yacht for Pride 2033?

A private yacht charter gives you total control over your Pride experience. No crowded beaches, no queues for drinks, and no noise restrictions. You set the playlist, choose the route, and decide when to stop for a swim. Marbella's coastline offers sheltered coves like Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés, perfect for anchoring away from the crowds. Plus, with the iconic La Concha mountain as your backdrop, every photo opportunity is Insta-worthy. Our all-inclusive pricing means you don't have to worry about a thing – just turn up and celebrate.

Our Fleet for Pride 2033

We have a boat for every group size and budget. All depart from Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella's luxury marina. Here's a quick overview:

Pride 2033 Itineraries: What to Expect

Most Pride charters start from Puerto Banús, where you can board your yacht and set off along the Marbella coastline. Popular routes include:

  • Sunset cruise to Cala del Faro – 2-hour trip, perfect for golden hour photos and a glass of cava.
  • Full-day to Cabopino – 8-hour charter with swimming stops, lunch on board, and views of the dunes.
  • Estepona escape – 4+ hours south to the charming port of Estepona, with its colourful old town visible from the water.
  • Banús bay party – stay close to the marina, anchor near the famous yachts, and enjoy the buzz of Pride from the sea.

Our skippers know the best spots for calm waters, good snorkelling, and avoiding the wind. Just let them know your preferences.

What's Included – No Hidden Costs

We believe in transparent pricing. Every charter includes: a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks (like crisps, nuts, olives), full insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no extra fees for cleaning, crew tips, or port taxes. The only thing you need to bring is your own swimwear, sunscreen, and Pride flags. For larger groups, we can arrange catering upgrades – just ask when booking.

Booking Tips for Pride 2033

Pride week in Marbella (typically late June to early July) is one of the busiest periods of the year. Boats book out weeks in advance, especially the popular Tier A options like the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39. We recommend:

  • Booking at least 3 weeks ahead for guaranteed availability.
  • Choosing a 4-hour charter as a minimum – 2 hours can feel rushed for a party.
  • Considering a morning or afternoon slot if sunset is already taken.
  • Contacting us via WhatsApp for larger yachts or custom requests.

For the best value, the Tier A boats at €749/2h or €2,299/8h are unbeatable. For a showstopper, the Mangusta 80 at €4,719/4h includes a free jet ski – perfect for adrenaline lovers.
